newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates steady amid high supply.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates steady amid high supply.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates ended steady on Sunday amid rising supplies and may go down in the next few sessions, dealers said.
"The supply is gearing up and the prices are under pressure," dealer Adil Nasim said.
He said spinners were buying quality stuff but the pace may slow down as they expect prices to fall lower in the short term.
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was traded in the range of 2,000 ($53.96) to 2,100 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), dealers said.
